hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; if [[ "$f" == *.py ]]; then python -m py_compile "$f" 2>/dev/null && echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PostToolUse\",\"additionalContext\":\"✓ Syntax OK: $f\"}}" || echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PostToolUse\",\"additionalContext\":\"✗ SYNTAX ERROR in $f — fix before committing\"}}"; fi; } || true

jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | grep -q 'git push' && { bad=$(find . -maxdepth 2 -name '*.py' -not -path './.git/*' -not -name '__init__.py' | while read -r f; do [ "$(wc -l < "$f")" -eq 0 ] && [ "$(wc -c < "$f")" -gt 10 ] && echo "$f"; done | head -5 | tr '\n' ' '); if [ -n "$bad" ]; then printf '{"continue":false,"stopReason":"BLOCKED: Corrupted .py files (single-line with embedded \\n): %s — fix with Write tool before pushing"}' "$bad"; else true; fi; } || true

jq -r '.tool_input.path // empty' | grep -q '\.py$' && echo '{"continue":false,"stopReason":"BLOCKED: mcp__github__create_or_update_file corrupts Python files by flattening newlines. Use: Edit/Write → git add → git commit → git push"}' || true

jq -r '[.tool_input.files // [] | .[].path] | .[] // empty' 2>/dev/null | grep -q '\.py$' && echo '{"continue":false,"stopReason":"BLOCKED: mcp__github__push_files corrupts Python files by flattening newlines. Use: Edit/Write → git add → git commit → git push"}' || true
